dataRoles.name: rows
dataRoles.description: Row hierarchy: up to three fields, outermost first.

dataRoles.name: period
dataRoles.description: Time axis of the sparklines: a month, week or date field.

dataRoles.name: values
dataRoles.description: One to three measures. The first one draws the sparkline.

dataRoles.name: target
dataRoles.description: Measure drawn as a target line on every sparkline.

dataRoles.name: rowImage
dataRoles.description: Image at the start of each row: a text measure or column (First) with a data:image Base64 URI. Web links are not loaded.

dataRoles.name: plan
dataRoles.description: Planned or budgeted figure. Shown as a reference column; variance columns and bars are part of the Pro plan.

dataRoles.name: previousYear
dataRoles.description: The same figure for the prior year. Shown as a reference column; variance columns and bars are part of the Pro plan.

dataRoles.name: forecast
dataRoles.description: Forecast or latest estimate. Shown as a reference column; variance against it is part of the Pro plan.

dataRoles.name: tooltips
dataRoles.description: Extra measures shown in the tooltip.
